records.title: MoDEM: Mixture of Domain Expert Models
records.reason: MoDEM routes prompts with a BERT router to domain-specialized expert LLMs and reports a better performance-to-cost ratio; a model-zoo deployment pattern, but the contribution is domain specialization rather than serving mechanics.

records.title: IMPACT: Importance-Aware Activation Space Reconstruction
records.reason: IMPACT performs importance-aware low-rank reconstruction of LLM activation spaces to compress large models for resource-constrained deployment; direct LLM compression for inference.

records.title: Finger Movement Estimation From Surface EMG Using Mamba Architecture
records.reason: Title itself states the work estimates finger movements from surface EMG signals using a Mamba architecture, a biomedical signal-estimation application; no inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: HOIMamba: Bidirectional State-Space Modeling for Monocular 3D Human–Object Interaction Reconstruction
records.reason: Title itself states the work reconstructs monocular 3D human-object interactions with bidirectional state-space modeling, a computer-vision reconstruction application; no inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: PARSE-Ego4D: Personal Action Recommendation Suggestions for Egocentric Videos
records.reason: PARSE-Ego4D releases LLM-generated personal action recommendation annotations for egocentric videos; a dataset/annotation contribution with no inference-system content.

records.title: Per-Axis Weight Deltas for Frequent Model Updates
records.reason: Stores fine-tuned model variants as 1-bit per-axis-scaled weight deltas with a streamlined loader, attacking checkpoint size and cold-start latency when serving many task-specialized LLMs; direct serving-system contribution.

records.title: Permutation-Equivariant 2D State Space Models: Theory and Canonical Architecture for Multivariate Time Series
records.reason: Characterizes permutation-equivariant 2D state-space models theoretically and applies them to multivariate time-series modeling; theory plus a forecasting-domain architecture, not inference systems.

records.title: SCRWKV: Ultra-Compact Structure-Calibrated Vision-RWKV for Topological Crack Segmentation
records.reason: Title itself states the work performs topological crack segmentation with an ultra-compact Vision-RWKV, an industrial image-segmentation application; no LLM inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: LAPLEX: The FFT of Learnable Laplace Kernels
records.reason: LAPLEX defines trainable Laplace-kernel operators with FFT-like scaling for matrix-vector multiplication up to 1e9 dimensions; a general operator primitive that could serve inference, but no inference-system evaluation is given.

records.title: NarrativeWorldBench: A Frontier-Saturated Benchmark and a Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Co-Creative Audio Drama
records.reason: NarrativeWorldBench benchmarks long-horizon co-creative audio drama generation and adds a latent world model; capability evaluation for a creative application, not inference systems.

records.title: Bounded Personas Match Retrieval on Classification but Not Regression for a Frozen Agent
records.reason: PersonaLink distills user history into a bounded persona compared against retrieval at inference time for a frozen agent, explicitly trading per-query context cost against accuracy; inference-adjacent, but a personalization method, not a serving technique.

records.title: Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
records.reason: KITE selects task-oriented key layers whose KV states are transmitted for latent multi-agent collaboration, cutting the communication and computation overhead of KV-based latent communication; direct KV-cache communication optimization.

records.title: STRATA: Self-Maintaining Structured Experience Graphs for Self-Evolving Language Agents
records.reason: STRATA organizes agent experience into a self-maintaining three-layer graph for test-time self-evolution; agent memory architecture adjacent to inference cost, but no serving or decoding mechanism.

records.title: ReLIC: A recipe for 64k steps In-Context Reinforcement Learning for Embodied AI
records.reason: ReLIC trains embodied agents for in-context RL over 64k steps with partial policy updates and a Sink-KV attention tweak; an RL training recipe for robot navigation, not an LLM inference system.

records.title: AViLA: Asynchronous Vision-Language Agent for Streaming Multimodal Data Interaction
records.reason: AViLA frames query-evidence asynchrony for streaming vision-language agents and grounds responses in past and future streams; a streaming agent framework whose efficiency aspect is secondary to the interaction problem.

records.title: LV-MAE: Learning Long Video Representations Through Masked-Embedding Autoencoders
records.reason: LV-MAE is a self-supervised masked-embedding autoencoder framework for long-video representations; representation learning with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Mamba2D: A Natively Multi-Dimensional State-Space Model for Vision Tasks
records.reason: Mamba2D re-derives selective SSMs with a native 2D scan for vision tasks and reports parameter-efficient ImageNet results; an efficient vision architecture, not an LLM inference system.

records.title: MUG: Pseudo Labeling Augmented Audio-Visual Mamba Network for Audio-Visual Video Parsing
records.reason: MUG is an audio-visual Mamba network with pseudo-labeling for weakly-supervised audio-visual video parsing; a perception-task architecture with no inference-system content.

records.title: FlashRNA: An Efficient Model for Regulatory Genomics
records.reason: Title itself states the work is an efficient model for regulatory genomics (FlashRNA), a computational-biology application; no LLM inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: Efficient-Empathy: Towards Efficient and Effective Selection of Empathy Data
records.reason: Efficient-Empathy selects sensibility/rationality training data for empathetic dialogue models; data curation for a capability, not an inference system.

records.title: Improving Multimodal Brain Encoding Model with Dynamic Subject-awareness Routing
records.reason: AFIRE/MIND route multimodal tokens with subject-aware MoE gating to predict whole-brain fMRI responses; a neuroscience encoding-model application, not inference systems.

records.title: The metamorphosis of machine translation: The rise of neural machine translation and its challenges
records.reason: A survey of machine translation's evolution from rule-based to neural approaches and their challenges; a historical overview with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: MS-NET-v2: modular selective network optimized by systematic generation of expert modules
records.reason: MS-NET-v2 constructs modular expert subsets with selective inference execution for DNNs, improving adaptive-inference efficiency; generic modular inference, not LLM-specific serving.

records.title: EDVM: End-to-End Autonomous Driving Model with Vision Mamba
records.reason: Title itself states the work is an end-to-end autonomous driving model with Vision Mamba, a self-driving perception/planning application; no inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: DualRAG: A Dual-Process Approach to Integrate Reasoning and Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
records.reason: DualRAG couples reasoning-augmented querying with progressive knowledge aggregation for multi-hop QA; a retrieval-reasoning framework for answer quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Lumilake: An Agentic Analytics Engine for AI4Science
records.reason: Lumilake is an agentic analytics engine whose LLM-aware query optimization consolidates shared prefixes to maximize KV-cache reuse across workflow calls; it contains a real KV-reuse optimization, but the system target is analytics workflow execution, not LLM serving itself.

records.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents
records.reason: A survey taxonomizing self-evolving coding agents (what evolves, when, and driven by which code signals); a literature synthesis with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Know in AdVance: Linear-Complexity Forecasting of Ad Campaign Performance with Evolving User Interest
records.reason: Title itself states the work forecasts advertising campaign performance from evolving user interest, a marketing prediction application; no inference-system technique is indicated in the title.

records.title: Compass-Thinker-7B Technical Report
records.reason: Compass-Thinker-7B is a technical report on an RL pipeline and curated data for training a 7B reasoning model; training work with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: KiF: Accelerating Low-Batch LLM Inference Using In-Flash KV Cache
records.reason: KiF manages the KV cache inside flash chips with pseudo-SLC write management and an in-flash GEMV accelerator, delivering up to 4.1x throughput over SSD KV offloading for low-batch edge LLM inference; direct KV-cache system.

records.title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
records.reason: MMFlash adapts diffusion-drafter speculative decoding to vision-language models using a token-level visual-dependence metric to raise acceptance; direct speculative decoding for multimodal inference.

records.title: Accelerated Optimization of Large Mixture-of-Experts Models by Density-Aware Multi-Stage Learning
records.reason: Proposes density-aware multi-stage (easy-to-hard) learning to accelerate training of large MoE models; training optimization only, with no inference application stated.

records.title: Architecting Long-Context Large Language Model Acceleration With Packing–Prefetch Scheduler and Ultralarge Capacity On-Chip Memories
records.reason: Proposes a packing-prefetch scheduler with ultra-large on-chip M3D memories that hides KV-cache transfer overhead in long-context LLM inference, reporting 8.06x decode speedup; direct inference architecture.

records.title: DIAA: A Decoding-Efficient Inference Acceleration Approach for On-Device Large Language Models
records.reason: DIAA accelerates on-device LLM speculative decoding without a separate draft model's memory burden and with adaptive token trees; direct decoding acceleration for edge inference.

records.title: Leveraging Speculative Sampling and KV-Cache Optimizations Together for Generative AI using OpenVINO
records.reason: Demonstrates combining speculative sampling with KV-cache optimizations in OpenVINO to reduce text-generation latency; a direct, if tutorial-style, inference optimization contribution.

records.title: Birds in Cages: Edge Inference Allocation for Distributed LLM Deployment
records.reason: Formulates allocation of distributed LLM inference tasks across heterogeneous edge servers under differing latency requirements and generative resource uncertainty; direct edge inference scheduling.

records.title: Investigating Mixture of Experts in Dense Retrieval
records.reason: Investigates adding a single MoE block to dense retrieval models and measures retrieval effectiveness across benchmarks; an IR modeling study, not inference systems.

records.title: Node-wise Filtering in Graph Neural Networks: A Mixture of Experts Approach
records.reason: Node-MoE selects graph filters per node with mixture-of-experts for node classification on mixed homophily graphs; a GNN modeling contribution, not inference systems.

records.title: SpecEdit: Training-Free Acceleration for Diffusion based Image Editing via Semantic Locking
records.reason: SpecEdit accelerates diffusion-based image editing with training-free semantic-locked dynamic resolution; an inference acceleration method, but for image diffusion models rather than LLM inference.

records.title: TRINE: A Token-Aware, Runtime-Adaptive FPGA Inference Engine for Multimodal AI
records.reason: TRINE is a single-bitstream FPGA inference engine and compiler unifying ViT/CNN/GNN/Transformer layers with in-stream token pruning and dependency-aware kernel offloading; inference accelerator hardware including Transformer workloads.

records.title: Efficient Low-Precision GEMM on Ascend NPU: HGEMM's Synergy of Pipeline Scheduling, Tiling, and Memory Optimization
records.reason: HGEMM implements low-precision GEMM on Ascend NPUs with dual-stream pipeline scheduling, tiling and memory optimization for CNN and LLM workloads; a core inference/training kernel contribution for matrix multiplication.

records.title: HEART-VIT: Hessian-Guided Efficient Dynamic Attention and Token Pruning in Vision Transformer
records.reason: HEART-ViT prunes tokens and attention heads in Vision Transformers using Hessian-guided sensitivity; efficient ViT inference, but a vision-only model with no LLM serving connection.

records.title: MPQ-DMv2: Flexible Residual Mixed Precision Quantization for Low-Bit Diffusion Models With Temporal Distillation
records.reason: MPQ-DMv2 is a mixed-precision quantization framework for extremely low-bit diffusion models with temporal distillation; quantization for inference, but targeting image diffusion models, not LLMs.

records.title: Surviving Resource-constraint Compression: Capability Retention under Tensor-train Decomposition for Sub-billion Parameter Language Models
records.reason: Compresses sub-billion language models by tensor-train decomposition of token embeddings without extra training data, targeting storage and memory limits of low-end devices; direct LM compression for deployment.

records.title: A Simulator for LLM Inference Systems Exploiting CXL Memory Pools
records.reason: Builds a simulator extending LLMServingSim with CXL memory-pool modeling to study LLM inference systems that share parameters across servers; direct inference-systems measurement infrastructure.

records.title: ELAS: Efficient Pre-Training of Low-Rank Large Language Models via 2:4 Activation Sparsity
records.reason: ELAS pre-trains low-rank LLMs with 2:4 activation sparsity to cut training memory and raise throughput; pre-training efficiency only, no inference application.

records.title: CentriQ: Calibration-Free Quantization of Diffusion Transformers via Exact Mean Centering
records.reason: CentriQ quantizes diffusion Transformers to 4 bits calibration-free via exact mean centering; an inference quantization method, but for image-generation DiTs rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs
records.reason: GateRQ stores quantized conditional-memory (Engram) rows as ladders of 1-bit residual codes selected per lookup by the retrieval gate, serving long-tail facts from LLM memory at low precision; direct quantized memory for LLM inference.

records.title: Joint Caching and Inference for Large Language Models in Wireless Networks
records.reason: Jointly optimizes LLM caching at edge servers, inference task scheduling and compute allocation to minimize serving delay under time-varying model popularity; direct LLM serving-system optimization.

records.title: Efficiently Training A Flat Neural Network Before It has been Quantizated
records.reason: Trains flat full-precision networks so later post-training quantization of ViTs loses less accuracy; a training-side preconditioning method for quantization, evaluated on vision Transformers.
